Lead · Iran deadline / Ukraine deep strike

The Iran deal clock expired without a formal agreement.

In plain terms: the May 31 deadline passed with no signed deal, markets are pricing peace as unlikely, and Ukraine widened the war the same night.

Polymarket's US–Iran peace deal by May 31 prints at 4%, down from 8% a week ago; the Hormuz blockade-lifting contract fell from 33% to 18% in 48 hours. In the same window Ukraine's SBU destroyed two Tu-142 maritime patrol aircraft and an Iskander system at Taganrog and struck the Feodosiya oil terminal in Crimea. Russia retaliated with 290 drones; air defences claimed 284 kills. Crimea began fuel rationing at 20 L/person/day.
